audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Ziggs / Skill / Ziggs. The mirror (pantheon__ziggs) settled it as Pantheon for levels 1-3, Skill at 4-5, Pantheon at 6, Ziggs from first item onward. The page also contradicted itself: whys[1] and whys[2] already said Pantheon owns levels 2-5 while win[1] and win[2] said Ziggs.
audit.why: Comet Spear costs 25 mana, Shield Vault is a 600-range dash stun on 13s against your 20s Satchel Charge, and Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front. Grand Starfall lands from 5500, so level 6 is his pick, not yours. Your edge is items and wave-clear, which is the first-item row and later.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 4 to Pantheon and row 5 to Ziggs, as matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs in one atomic group, with five ratings and five why lines moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your Mega Inferno Bomb spike and first item as a Pantheon spike — both backwards — and no ult timer appeared.
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s at 5500 range; Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70s at 5000. His is the bigger, rarer swing and it puts him on top of you, which is what makes level 6 his row. By first item his all-in curve flattens while your poke and wave-clear keep climbing.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and whys[4] restated as his spike with the 5500 range; whys[5] and spikes[2].text restated as yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text says 'his passive blocks your Short Fuse autos'. It does not — Mortal Will only empowers his next spell; the blocking is Aegis Assault (E), and only from the front. wants.foe[1] repeated the same error. No cooldowns appeared anywhere, and dosFull[2].d / dontsFull[0].d were filler.
audit.why: Getting the blocker wrong changes the answer: a passive you cannot play around versus a 22s channel you can walk around or interrupt. Aegis Assault is a channel — Satchel Charge's knockup cancels it, which is the single most valuable thing your W does in this lane and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: Blocker corrected to Aegis Assault, front-only, 22s, in spikes[2].text and wants.foe[1]; the Satchel-cancels-the-channel interaction written into dontsFull[0].d; 13s and 20s into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d and phases[1].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Read it like a second minimap' with no cooldown given.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s and Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s — his engage is back before your escape is, so 'W is down' is not the same as 'safe'.

notes: Chart proposed as five matched side/win pairs in one atomic group, following the mirror's shape (Pantheon 1-3, Skill 4-5, Pantheon 6, Ziggs from first item). This side's packet disagrees (66.67% over 9 games, a Ziggs-leaning chart) — mirror was followed per the rule, and the kit numbers support it. The load-bearing factual fix is that Aegis Assault (E), not Mortal Will (P), is the blocker, and only from the front. Aegis Assault carries the 'channel' flag, so Satchel Charge's knockup interrupting it is stated — but whether the front-block would absorb the Satchel damage first is NOT in the kit text and is not claimed. Also unasserted: whether Shield Vault's stun is reduced by tenacity or cleansable.
